company.description:
Juno College of Technology provides a comprehensive and accelerated training for students. With Juno College's proven process, students can spend the shortest possible amount of time out of the workforce while being set up for a career. Juno College of Technology is an expert at training non-technical people and turning them into employable and high-earning web developers.

Juno College of Technology was founded on 2012 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
